name: Contractor Foreman
summary: Construction management — estimating, scheduling, daily logs and financial tracking — priced per company rather than per seat, with unlimited projects on every tier.
best_for: small and mid-size contractors who want estimating, scheduling and daily logs in one place and can commit to a year — the company-wide fee makes it cheap per head once you have a crew
skip_if: you are a sole trader with a handful of jobs, because Basic at $49 a month annual is real money against a spreadsheet and a calendar — though the 30-day trial and the conditional 100-day refund mean trying it costs nothing but your time
honest_knock: Credit where it is due first: this is company pricing with unlimited projects and no per-user overage inside your tier, which is rare in construction software and genuinely cheaper than per-seat rivals for a crew. The catch is the billing term. Monthly costs 20% to 32% more than annual on the same plan — $139 against $105 on Standard — and Basic is sold on annual billing only, so the cheapest way in requires a year paid up front. The user counts are the real ladder: 1, 3, 8, 15, unlimited. A five-person crew is not on Standard at $105, it is on Plus at $166, so count your licence holders before you compare against anything else.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month billed annually for the whole company with 1 user
pricing.notes: (re-verified 11 Oct 2026 on their own pricing page: annual prices unchanged since 1 Aug 2026; the quarterly option recorded on 28 Aug 2026 has been replaced by monthly billing) Priced for the company rather than per seat, with unlimited projects on every tier, and annual plans open with 30 days free before the first bill; monthly plans are charged at sign-up. Annual: Basic $49/month ($588 a year, 1 user), Standard $105 ($1,264, 3 users), Plus $166 ($1,997, 8 users), Pro $221 ($2,654, 15 users), Unlimited $332 ($3,984, unlimited users). Monthly billing costs more for the same plans: Standard $139, Plus $199, Pro $279, Unlimited $399 a month; Basic is 'Available for Annual' only. The page's 'Save' figures match twelve monthly payments against the annual total: $404, $391, $694 and $804. Their own wording: the fee listed is the fee for the company as a whole. Card payments taken through the built-in Stripe integration are billed separately at 2.9% + $0.30 a transaction (3.9% + $0.30 for Amex, 1% + $0.30 capped at $10.00 for ACH).
